entities.description: Niko Karppinen's personal consulting website for practical measurement, SEO, analytics and AI-assisted workflows.

hasChunks.text: I like untangling messy tracking setups, bringing scattered reports together and making site structures clearer. I want people to understand what is happening and decide what to do next.

entities.name: Niko Karppinen
entities.description: SEO and web analytics consultant working since 2017 across ecommerce, telecoms, public sector, consumer and B2B. He turns messy tracking and reporting into systems teams can measure and explain.

hasChunks.text: I have worked with SEO, analytics, and digital marketing since 2017. In that time, I have worked with organisations in ecommerce, telecommunications, insurance, healthcare, the public sector, B2B, and consumer services.
AI can help apply a clear process more consistently. It does not fix bad source data, unclear ownership, or a process that nobody really understands.

entities.name: Expert Panel prompt
entities.description: A prompt pattern that casts an AI as a roundtable of three experts who debate a question until they reach a practical recommendation.

hasChunks.text: The “Expert Panel” prompt fixes that. It turns your AI into a small roundtable of three professionals with different incentives who argue, push back, and refine ideas until they reach a practical conclusion. The output feels closer to a real strategy session than a neutral Wikipedia-style overview.
hasChunks.pageTitle: Use AI for multi-expert analysis with one prompt

hasChunks.text: You act as the director. The AI plays three experts. The value comes from the tension between them.
hasChunks.pageTitle: Use AI for multi-expert analysis with one prompt

entities.name: SCQR and Pyramid Principle
entities.description: The Situation–Complication–Question–Resolution storyline paired with the Pyramid Principle, used to structure executive presentations.

hasChunks.text: The SCQR (Situation–Complication–Question–Resolution) structure is the foundation of a compelling executive narrative. It moves the audience from shared context to a decision point.
hasChunks.pageTitle: Create McKinsey-style presentation using ChatGPT or Gemini

hasChunks.text: That’s why consultants at McKinsey, BCG, and Bain rely on a strict logic framework called the SCQR and Pyramid Principle to structure every presentation. It turns messy findings into a clear narrative that moves from insight to action.
hasChunks.pageTitle: Create McKinsey-style presentation using ChatGPT or Gemini

entities.name: Donatello Optimization System
entities.description: A meta-prompt that turns rough inputs into precise prompts using a four-step DECONSTRUCT–DIAGNOSE–DEVELOP–DELIVER method.

hasChunks.text: The Donatello Optimization System is a powerful "meta-prompt" that establishes the AI as a master-level prompt engineer. Its purpose is to take your rough, vague inputs and systematically transform them into highly precise, effective prompts that guarantee better, more reliable results from your LLM.
hasChunks.pageTitle: Use prompt optimization system to create better prompts in ChatGPT

hasChunks.text: Donatello applies a rigorous 4-step framework and advanced techniques (like Chain-of-Thought or Role Assignment) to your prompt, then outputs the improved version in a clean, easy-to-use format.
hasChunks.pageTitle: Use prompt optimization system to create better prompts in ChatGPT

entities.name: Cookiebot guide
entities.description: A simplified walkthrough for installing Cookiebot and wiring Consent Mode defaults, including where to place the code.

hasChunks.text: This guide takes a direct Cookiebot website implementation from adding the scripts to browser validation. Site owners can use the implementation notes, marketing and analytics specialists can use the expected consent states, and developers can copy and adapt the generated code.

Basic and Advanced Consent Mode describe when a tag loads, not which default snippet you copy. With Basic Consent Mode, the tag stays blocked until the relevant consent is granted. With Advanced Consent Mode, the tag loads with denied defaults and sends limited cookieless measurements.

entities.name: AI-assisted digital workflows
entities.description: Niko's framing of AI in digital work: practical, repeatable workflows where AI supports decisions but humans stay in the loop.

hasChunks.text: Tools can surface patterns, but people still decide what matters for the customer, the business, and the brand.
